title: Summative Test 2 — Earth Materials, Geologic & Weather Hazards
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: Which is the hardest mineral on the Mohs scale?
options: Diamond
Quartz crystal
Talc powder
Calcite rock

questions.text: Which rock is the main raw material for cement?
options: Limestone
Basalt rock
Granite slab
Obsidian glass

questions.text: How does a metamorphic rock form?
options: Heat and pressure change existing rock
Magma cools quickly at the surface
Sediments settle and become cemented together
Salt water evaporates in shallow seas
questions.correct: Heat and pressure change existing rock

questions.text: Why is streak more reliable than surface color for identifying minerals?
options: Powder color stays the same
Surface color never changes
Streak shows the mineral's weight
Streak measures the hardness

questions.text: Which metal mined in Surigao is used in stainless steel?
options: Nickel
Mercury
Silver
Tin

questions.text: Why are minerals considered non-renewable?
options: They take millions of years to form
They grow back after every rainy season
They are made by plants in the forest
They can be produced quickly in factories
questions.correct: They take millions of years to form

questions.text: A farmer's clay soil becomes waterlogged after rain. What should she add to improve it?
options: Compost and some sand
More clay from a river
Plastic sheets on top
Cement to firm it up

questions.text: A town must decide whether to allow a quarry beside its river. Which condition is MOST important to require?
options: Silt control plus replanting afterward
A promise to pay for a new basketball court
A larger sign at the quarry entrance
Permission to dump waste rock in the river

questions.text: What is the point inside Earth where an earthquake starts?
options: Focus
Epicenter
Fault scarp line
Seismograph

questions.text: Which volcano erupted explosively in 1991, cooling global temperatures?
options: Mount Pinatubo
Mount Apo
Mount Pulag
Mount Banahaw (Quezon)

questions.text: Why are pyroclastic flows so deadly?
options: They are fast and extremely hot
They move slowly and are cool
They are made only of rainwater
They happen only under the ocean
questions.correct: They are fast and extremely hot

questions.text: How does an undersea earthquake create a tsunami?
options: It suddenly moves the sea floor and water
It heats the water until the sea boils over
It pulls the Moon closer to the Earth
It blows strong winds across the sea
questions.correct: It suddenly moves the sea floor and water

questions.text: Which is a SLOW geologic process?
options: Soil erosion
Earthquake
Pyroclastic flow
Tsunami wave

questions.text: How does deforestation speed up soil erosion?
options: Roots no longer hold the soil
Trees make the soil too heavy
Leaves block all rain from soil
Forests make the slopes steeper
questions.correct: Roots no longer hold the soil

questions.text: You feel strong shaking while near the shore, and the sea starts to drop. Which action is BEST?
options: Move to high ground at once
Stay to watch the water move
Walk out to see the sea floor
Wait for the shaking to repeat
questions.correct: Move to high ground at once

questions.text: Lahars kept burying towns for years after Pinatubo erupted. Why did the danger last so long?
options: Rain kept washing loose ash down
The volcano kept erupting every week
Ash slowly turned into hot lava
Earthquakes pushed ash into rivers
questions.correct: Rain kept washing loose ash down

questions.text: Over what kind of water do typhoons form?
options: Warm ocean water
Cold polar seas
Freshwater lakes
Frozen bays

questions.text: What are the wind speeds for PAGASA Signal No. 4?
options: 39–61 km/h only

questions.text: What is a flash flood?
options: Water rising very fast after intense rain
A slow flood that lasts for several months
A flood caused only by high ocean tides
Water from melting snow in the mountains
questions.correct: Water rising very fast after intense rain

questions.text: Which warning sign suggests a landslide may happen?
options: New cracks on a hillside
A clear blue sky at noon
Birds singing in the trees
A cool breeze at night

questions.text: Why does the heat index feel higher than the actual temperature on humid days?
options: Sweat evaporates more slowly
The Sun is closer on humid days
Humid air has less oxygen in it
Water vapor burns the skin directly

questions.text: PAGASA issues an Orange rainfall warning for your area. What should your family do?
options: Get ready to evacuate if water rises
Ignore it, since it is not a Red warning yet
Go swimming in the rising river
Drive across flooded roads now
questions.correct: Get ready to evacuate if water rises

questions.text: Two coastal towns face the same typhoon. Town A has wide mangroves; Town B cleared its mangroves. Which likely suffers MORE storm-surge damage, and why?
options: Town B — no mangroves to slow the waves
Town A — mangroves make waves taller
Both equal — mangroves have no effect on waves
Town A — mangroves attract typhoons
questions.correct: Town B — no mangroves to slow the waves

questions.text: What began in the Neolithic period that started changing landforms?
options: Farming and permanent settlements
Large steel factories and railways
Highways and land reclamation
Mega-dams and coal power plants

questions.text: What is vulnerability in DRRM?
options: How easily people are harmed
How strong the hazard is in a place
How often PAGASA issues a warning
How fast a typhoon moves over land

questions.text: How do mangroves reduce disaster risk?
options: They slow waves and hold soil
They make the sea level drop
They stop all typhoons forming
They raise the land by meters
questions.correct: They slow waves and hold soil

questions.text: Why can land reclamation increase flooding nearby?
options: It can block natural drainage paths
It lowers the sea level along coasts
It removes the clouds above a city
It makes the rain fall more slowly
questions.correct: It can block natural drainage paths

questions.text: Your barangay's drains are clogged with plastic every rainy season. Which action BEST reduces the flood risk?
options: Segregate waste; clean drains often
Burn the plastic inside the drains
Pave the creek banks with concrete
Close the drains to keep out trash

questions.text: Landslides increased in a mountain town after a quarry and new roads cut into its slopes. What is the BEST explanation?
options: Cut slopes and lost plants weakened them
Quarries produce extra rain over the whole town
Roads attract lightning that loosens soil
Rock removal makes the mountain grow taller
questions.correct: Cut slopes and lost plants weakened them

questions.text: Officials must choose a site for a new evacuation center. Which choice is BEST?
options: High ground, away from rivers, faults and coasts
Beside the river, so rescue boats can reach it easily
On the beach, so people can see the storm
At the foot of a steep, deforested slope
questions.correct: High ground, away from rivers, faults and coasts
